courses.title: Node.js Essential Training
courses.why: A short, practical pass over the Node.js core (modules, file system, I/O, running JavaScript on the server) by Eve Porcello; quick to finish and a clean certificate for the Node.js skill.

courses.title: Building RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express
courses.why: Covers building and testing an Express REST API end to end, which matches the node-apis chapter and the project for this path.

courses.title: TypeScript for Node.js Developers
courses.why: The most current of the three: modern TypeScript features (decorators, Disposable/AsyncDisposable) applied in Node.js projects, which is how Node is written in most teams today.

portals.name: Node.js Learn (official)
portals.what: The official guides on the event loop, asynchronous work, streams, file system and modules; the reference to check answers against.

portals.name: roadmap.sh: Node.js questions
portals.what: A bank of Node.js interview questions with short answers, good for a quick self-quiz after each chapter.

portals.name: LeetCode: 30 Days of JavaScript
portals.what: Thirty small problems on closures, promises, timers and function composition, the async JavaScript that Node interviews test.

portals.name: NodeSchool
portals.what: Free self-guided terminal workshops (learnyounode, stream-adventure) that make you write real Node.js code against automatic checks.

assessments.name: Node (Basic) certification
assessments.format: 1-hour online test, 2 coding questions, one attempt (topics include package and module management)
assessments.credential: HackerRank certificate with a shareable URL for LinkedIn and your resume
assessments.why: The quickest Node-specific credential. The OpenJS JSNAD and JSNSD exams were retired on 30 September 2025, so HackerRank's Node certificates are now the main Node-specific option.

assessments.name: Node.js (Intermediate) certification
assessments.format: 1-hour online test, 2 coding questions, one attempt (topics include event-driven architecture)
assessments.credential: HackerRank certificate with a shareable URL
assessments.why: The level a senior engineer should show; it tests event-driven Node code rather than syntax.

assessments.name: Rest API (Intermediate) certification
assessments.format: 1 hr 30 min online test, 2 questions on working with APIs; one attempt only
assessments.credential: HackerRank certificate with a shareable URL
assessments.why: Pairs with the Node.js API work in this path and is a common filter in backend job applications.
